sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Combining complementary retrieval signals to find useful evidence.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A name index and a similarity map can help in different ways.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: An exact product name helps keyword search; a paraphrased question may benefit from vector similarity.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Hybrid retrieval combines keyword and semantic results; graph traversal remains a distinct available contract path.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Different queries need different signals; no single retrieval method is always best.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Do not depict vector, full-text and graph as one automatically fused three-way runtime pipeline. Provider inactivity and evaluation limits remain visible.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
